MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

3. When learning Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   D. Skip safety briefings for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .

4. When learning Pre- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre- production.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Pre- production.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre- production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre- production.

5. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Production.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Production.

6. When learning Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.

7. When learning Live streaming Project, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Live streaming Project.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Live streaming Project.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Live streaming Project.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Live streaming Project.

8. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

11. When learning Digital Video Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production.

12. When learning Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Photography: technology and techniques and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Digital Video Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
